categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: Matches the Docs label and directly edits developer notes and over a dozen release note snippet markdown files under doc/.
categories.rationale: Improves draft release note completeness and accuracy by adding missing PR references, fixing a version number, and documenting the convention in developer-notes.md. While not addressing critical user-facing misinformation, fixing release note snippets reduces manual tracking overhead during release assembly.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Adds a new release note lint check to the Rust test runner in test/lint/test_runner/src/lint_docs.rs.
categories.rationale: Adds a mechanical lint rule to enforce PR references in doc snippets. It prevents minor documentation omissions during CI rather than catching functional or regression bugs.
